title: My Decorations Are Alive
trend: Instagram Reels 'my Halloween decoration is alive' POV gag (peak trending Reels audio format the week of October 12–25, 2026) — a POV where the yard decorations come to life
youtube_title: POV: my Halloween decorations are alive and they have demands 👻
description:
I just wanted a spooky porch video. The ghost wants weekends off, the motion sensor screams at leaves, and the rubber rat is not rubber.

#mydecorationisalive #halloweendecor #halloween #pov #comedy #animation #shorts

lines.text: Okay. Day one of my Halloween decorations being alive. Everybody stay still.
Which one of us is supposed to move first?
Who said that?
The ghost. On the lawn. Twelve feet tall.
You're an inflatable. You were forty dollars.
Forty nine. With the stakes.
Movement detected. Good evening, terrible person.
The motion sensor talks too. Great.
I do not talk, madam. I announce.
Fine. Just act alive for the camera.
We are alive. Nobody ever asks us anything.
Like what?
You plugged me in September first. I've held my breath for seven weeks.
You don't breathe. You're nylon and a fan.
And the fan is in my lower back. Whirring.
I want weekends off. Deflated. Like a normal person.
Lying down. Two whole days. A dream.
Okay. Sensor. You're very scary.
Thank you. I have screamed at four hundred things this month.
It's October. We've had six trick or treaters.
I screamed at the mailman. He now delivers from the street.
I screamed at a leaf. A leaf, madam.
He screamed at his own reflection in the window.
I thought he was handsome. I panicked.
So what do you want?
Only to go off for the man who parks out front every morning with his engine running.
That's fair. Scream at him.
At least the rubber rat is quiet.
Thank you for noticing.
No. No, no. You were a dollar.
I was never in the store. I was in your shopping bag.
You didn't buy a rat. A rat moved in.
I'm not rubber. I'm relaxed.
She's very relaxed. She ate the whole candy bowl.
I blamed the kids! I made a sign! One per person!
I respected the sign. One at a time. Two hundred times.
I screamed every time. She finds it soothing.
It's like a little alarm clock for snacks.
Fine. Weekends, a list, and your own bowl.
The good candy. Not the raisins.
Deal. Now one scary moment for the video. Please.
Fine. On three. One. Two.
Movement detected!
Perfect. Posting it.
Wait. It already has a million views.
A million? I'll need a bigger fan.
The comments say the ghost looks so realistic.
And they want the rat to get her own show.
I accept. I'll need a very little chair.
And this one says, how did she get the lady animatronic to blink?
Which lady?
Me. They think I'm the decoration.
To be fair, you do have a very stiff wave.
You stood still for three minutes. Even I breathe more.
Four hundred people want to know where to buy you.
I am not for sale. I am a homeowner.
Stand by the candy bowl? Asking for business reasons.
Fine. One night. But I want weekends off.
Welcome to the porch. It's a lot of standing.
Movement detected. Good evening, decoration.
